annotation: Eight separate allocations M1 N2, two per line; row aggregation is arithmetic only. .7 headcount and .10-.13 unallocated smiths excluded by commodity and section. Damage to the first name does not damage its quantity.

Source describes the first roster and its total; missing VIR in individual entries is supplied by the roster context, explicitly discussed on p.172. Subsequent roster and reverse excluded. Edition reads to-sa; pinned DAMOS reads to-so. Numerical test does not adjudicate that lexical discrepancy.

p.171 distinguishes three sections and excludes first MAN in each section. Row .2 contains a gap; retained incompleteness. .4 contains restored [1]; .10 opens a broken stretch. Do not repair quantities to match 31.
First MAN of .12 excluded as directed by edition p.171; second retained. Restored [1] in .14 remains uncertain. Both sections belong to one object, never separate independent samples.

Sixteen surviving non-erased allocations; exclude erased seventeenth M5 in .10 and erased 5 in .11. Edition independently calls total an apparent error for L2 M20. Modern doubtful M/5 marks retained; mismatch is conditional on transcribed readings, not a strict certain-text result.

Whole allocation section .1-.10; blanks .11-.14 do not sever published total .15. DAMOS damaged V1 cells and uncertain oil adjunct retained; The damaged V cell on .5 is marked uncertain independently of its certain S cell. Source edition restores quantities. No strict completeness assertion.

Included because p.118 explicitly names Fp1 as summation. DAMOS .6/.7 have right-edge breaks. Visible amounts need not exhaust the account. .7-.10 inherit OLE within the published oil account, not globally.
Recto aggregate and reverse itemization identified as summation on p.118. Retain uncertain Z3 and right-edge break. Modern HORD assignment retained. No cross-commodity conversion.

Edition p.217 calls 18 oil units a repaid quantity and 38 the jars. to-so occurs, but supplies no itemized additive total. Book uses older designation Gn1184; DAMOS Fr1184. Never add containers to oil volume.
